A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SAGE and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. The complete 22-page v3 and 24-page v4 support comparison, including matching relocated appendix material.

before.justification: v3 reports original VPR benchmark results, component ablations, runtime and convergence measurements, sensitivity analyses, and qualitative retrieval results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and adds evaluations without InteractHead and further baseline comparison results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same DPN adaptation, Soft Probing, InteractHead, online graph construction, and greedy weighted sampling procedures. The new evaluation without the already optional InteractHead is an ablation, not a revision of the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: v4 Table 9 substantially expands environmental evaluation coverage through SVOX and its night, overcast, snow, rain, and sun conditions, plus dedicated SF-XL night and occlusion tests. SF-small was already evaluated in v3's appendix; SF-XL itself is therefore not entirely new coverage. The original training datasets remain unchanged.

E2.justification: v3 Table 13's comparison against VLAD-BuFF, EDTFormer, and EffoVPR expands into v4 Table 10 with MegaLoc, ImAge, SelaVPR, FoL-global/FoL, and SelaVPR++ entries. SelaVPR and FoL appeared elsewhere previously, but their inclusion broadens this particular comparison. The comparator sets in Tables 2–3 remain unchanged.

E3.justification: New settings include ViT-B/L evaluations with InteractHead disabled, additional SF-XL test splits, and Nordland-star using 2,760 summer queries against 27,592 winter reference images. These extend the evaluation protocol without revising the original training recipe or recall metrics. Newly stated resolutions and backbone details for retained comparisons do not establish that those experiments changed or were rerun.

E4.justification: v4 Table 9 adds a substantial investigation of dependence on cross-image interaction by evaluating both backbones without InteractHead, including dedicated night, occlusion, and weather conditions. v3 only varied InteractHead's internal dimensions. Existing component, runtime, convergence, descriptor-size, and threshold analyses are retained; the failure images themselves are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. The added tables continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Original main results and relocated descriptor sweeps, sensitivity results, and SF-small scores are unchanged. New Table 9 reports extensive results without InteractHead, including SAGE-L R@1 of 94.7 on Pitts30k-test and 98.1 on Tokyo24/7. Table 10 adds comparator results, including SelaVPR++-L's 97.2 Nordland R@1 versus SAGE's retained 96.0, and EffoVPR's previously missing 97.0 Pitts250k-test R@1. These are added results, not improvements to existing same-setting scores.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7, including the SoftP variance approximation and graph/sampling definitions, are unchanged. The appendix's ID/AID definition in Equation 8 is retained. No new assumptions, proofs, or mathematical derivations appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same methodological contributions, parameter-efficiency claims, and claimed state-of-the-art performance across eight benchmarks. The additional evaluations do not redefine these central claims.

C2.justification: v4's new A.3 expands v3's brief failure discussion into explanations involving similar road layouts, facades, perspective geometry, and transient visual evidence, with structural reasoning and local matching suggested as remedies. Section 4.4 also interprets effectiveness without InteractHead and acknowledges stronger SelaVPR++ results on some metrics. Existing GPS, scaling, and dynamic-scene limitations remain.

D1.justification: v4 adds a project-page address and repository links for MegaLoc, ImAge, and SelaVPR++. Table 10 newly specifies backbone variants, register usage, and EffoVPR's 504×504 resolution versus 322×322 for other methods. Table 9 and A.4 clarify Nordland query/reference arrangements. The original implementation and hardware disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: v4 adds citations to Region Matters, ImAge, DialogueVPR, and EfficientVPR, and adds descriptions of MegaLoc, ImAge, and SelaVPR++ in the compared-methods appendix. These update the research context without fundamentally changing SAGE's positioning. D2-VPR's preprint-to-publication update represents the same work.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main narrative remain intact. Local revisions standardize Soft Probing terminology, expand experimental and failure explanations, introduce A.3 Case Study, move the extended comparison into Section 4.4, reorder appendix discussion, and update acknowledgments and method-entry formatting.

P2.justification: v4 adds the multi-block Table 9 and expands and relocates v3 Table 13 as Table 10, with backbone labels, method grouping, and a more detailed caption. Existing appendix tables are reordered and renumbered, and figures are resized or relocated while retaining their content. The visual changes are localized.

improvement.justification: The evaluation without InteractHead makes dependence on cross-image context easier to assess, the expanded comparator set gives a more informative competitive assessment, and A.3 explains existing failures more usefully. These provide a limited net improvement. Several new scenarios lack detailed protocol documentation and corresponding full-model controls, while the broad SOTA language remains insufficiently qualified against some stronger results in Table 10.
